name: clear_rows_from_command_stream
description: Reads a byte-coded command stream: a zero byte ends it, a one byte zeroes four words in each of sixteen rows, and a space byte keeps the loop going. Any other byte is passed to a routine picked from a function table.

name: dispatch_to_table_entry
description: Calls one routine selected from a table by an index held in a register, then returns. The caller decides which entry is used.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on memory or registers.

name: merge_source_first_two_words
description: For a caller-supplied number of rows, clears the masked bits of four destination words and ORs a source word into the first two. It then runs the same byte-coded command stream as the clear routine, passing any other byte to a table entry.

name: merge_source_into_third_word
description: For a caller-supplied number of rows, clears the masked bits of four destination words and ORs a source word into only the third. It then runs the byte-coded command stream, passing any other byte to a table entry.

name: merge_source_into_alternate_words
description: For a caller-supplied number of rows, clears the masked bits of four destination words and ORs a source word into the first and third. It then runs the byte-coded command stream, passing any other byte to a table entry.

name: set_control_bits_then_dispatch
description: ORs a fixed bit pattern into one byte before the byte-coded command stream is read. The stream ends on a zero byte, a one byte zeroes four words in each of sixteen rows, and any other byte is passed to a table entry.

name: merge_source_first_three_words
description: For a caller-supplied number of rows, clears the masked bits of four destination words and ORs a source word into the first three. It then runs the byte-coded command stream, passing any other byte to a table entry.

name: merge_source_last_three_words
description: For a caller-supplied number of rows, clears the masked bits of four destination words and ORs a source word into the last three. It then runs the byte-coded command stream, passing any other byte to a table entry.

name: merge_source_all_four_words
description: For a caller-supplied number of rows, clears the masked bits of four destination words and ORs a source word into each of them. It then runs the byte-coded command stream, passing any other byte to a table entry.

name: write_four_hex_digits
description: Writes the four hexadecimal digits of a 16-bit value, most significant first, converting each nibble to an ASCII character and passing it to a character output routine at eight-unit steps. Returns the start position adjusted back by 24.

name: write_counted_hex_digits
description: Writes a caller-supplied count of hexadecimal digits from the top of a 16-bit value, converting each nibble to an ASCII character and passing it to a character output routine at eight-unit steps. Returns the start position adjusted back by 24.

name: clear_flag_byte
description: Writes zero to one global byte and returns the input value of a data register unchanged. The routine has no other effect.

name: reset_state_and_copy_block
description: Clears five state variables, sets two size values of 320 and 290, calls setup routines, and copies 8192 longwords from one buffer to another. The audio period register and color register 15 are also referenced.

name: set_global_longword_minus_two
description: Stores the signed value minus two into one global longword and returns. It has no other effect.

name: copy_variant_block_to_buffer
description: Chooses one of three source addresses from a selector global: value 1 picks one, value 2 another, and any other value the third. It then copies 680 blocks of twelve longwords to the destination and resets the selector to zero.

name: merge_split_bytes_from_source
description: Merges bytes from a source buffer into a destination buffer at fixed offsets forty bytes apart. In each set of rows the low bits of the destination byte are kept and the high bits come from the source, with the number of kept bits rising from one to seven across the sets; one byte is also ORed with a value passed in a register.

name: toggle_bit_and_zero_bytes
description: Flips one bit of a global byte, with the bit index taken from a byte in the structure modulo eight. It then writes zero to eight bytes spaced forty bytes apart in that structure.

name: force_high_bits_of_bytes
description: Forces the high bits of fourteen bytes at fixed offsets to fixed patterns while leaving their low bits unchanged. The offsets fall in four columns of rows spaced forty bytes apart.

name: write_palette_entry_one
description: Writes the decimal values 255 and 4095 in turn to the color register for palette entry one, then calls a routine. The two values are written in sequence with no other logic.

name: write_scaled_color_one_value
description: Writes zero to a global, then stores a word read from memory, doubled and increased by one, and calls a routine. The color register for palette entry one is the only hardware register referenced.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Only a trap call and a bad-data marker were recovered: the routine stores two values, issues a trap, and then the remaining code is invalid instruction data. No reliable behaviour beyond that can be stated.

name: configure_interrupts_and_build_table
description: Writes interrupt-control values and sets a vector, references the color register for entry zero, and builds a table of 200 entries rising in steps of 160. It then doubles and increments sixteen words and ends in bad instruction data, so the tail is not reliable.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on memory or registers.

name: step_countdown_table_entries
description: While a countdown global is nonzero, it decrements the global and passes the two words and the longword of an eight-byte table entry to a routine. The fourth argument is zero when the count is three and thirteen otherwise, and then another routine is called.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, with no other logic.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so no behaviour was recovered for this routine. It is a stub.

name: run_sequence_with_word_copy
description: Calls a few routines, copies sixteen words from one fixed buffer into another, then calls many more routines before returning. The copy is the only data movement in the routine.

name: call_routine_five_times
description: Calls the same routine five times in a row and returns.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so no behaviour was recovered for this routine. It is a stub.

name: clear_struct_header_and_call
description: Zeroes several fields at the start of a structure pointed to by a global, then calls ten routines in sequence.

name: or_xor_table_into_block
description: Loops eighty-eight times over a source table, ORing groups of longwords into a destination block at several fixed offsets, with some positions also XORed. Both pointers advance on each pass.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on memory or registers.

name: step_palette_toward_target
description: Steps each of sixteen color words one unit toward its target in the red, green and blue nibbles, then copies the sixteen results into a global buffer. The color register for entry zero is referenced.

name: fill_rows_with_cycling_longwords
description: Fills 200 rows of a buffer, forty longwords per row, by cycling through thirteen longwords read from memory. It then calls routines to set up the rest of the screen.

name: copy_buffer_and_process_table
description: Makes two fixed setup calls, copies 8000 longwords from one buffer to another, then loops over a table of four-word entries until a sentinel, calling a routine for each entry. The loop exits on a condition.

name: adjust_counter_from_input_bits
description: Adjusts a small counter in a global using the bits of a flag value: bit 0 decrements it with a floor, bit 1 increments it with a ceiling, and bit 2 steps it through clamped values. A routine is called on each pass of the loop.

name: step_counter_with_limits
description: Steps a state global with ceilings of twenty and two hundred, driven by bits of an input register value. It calls a routine once per pass.

name: step_counter_then_fade
description: Adjusts a state global using bits of an input value and ceilings of twenty and two hundred, then tail-branches into the fade routine. One further routine is called during the pass.

name: step_state_and_fill_rows
description: Steps a state global up to a ceiling of two hundred, then fills rows with a repeating set of thirteen longwords and calls a routine. The fill pattern is the same as in the row-fill routine elsewhere in this bundle.

name: run_tagged_state_menu_loop
description: Runs a loop that resets a state global, then dispatches on four-letter ASCII tag values, copying a block and calling routines for each tag. One tag branch waits for a flag to clear and then runs a short countdown.

name: advance_state_on_flag_bit
description: While bit 7 of a flag global is set, it advances a state global through fixed branches. One branch sets a tag, waits through a countdown and calls a routine with fixed arguments; another copies a block.

name: fill_rows_after_state_wait
description: When the state global equals four, it waits for the state to return to zero, then fills 200 rows with a cycling pattern of thirteen longwords read from memory. The fill logic matches the other row-fill routines in this bundle.

name: dispatch_tag_then_process_table
description: Waits for a flag to clear, then dispatches on four-letter tag values: one tag copies a 40-byte block to a fixed buffer and the others update the state global. It then makes several routine calls per pass.

name: process_tags_and_call_entries
description: Dispatches on four-letter tag values and updates the state global for each, then walks a sentinel-terminated table of eight-byte entries. Each entry's first two words and a longword are passed to a routine.

name: adjust_menu_state_from_bits
description: Adjusts a menu state global from the bits of a flag value, clamping it between fixed bounds and setting a four-letter tag from the new value. It then calls a routine with fixed arguments.

name: step_menu_state_with_tags
description: Steps a menu state global by the bits of an input flag, with a ceiling of two hundred for one state, and sets a four-letter tag before each call to a routine. It finishes with a check of the bit 7 flag.

name: run_menu_until_escape
description: Handles a menu-state step when bit 3 of an input flag is set, then loops over menu tags until the escape value, decimal 27, is seen. Routine calls are made on each pass.

name: run_menu_loop_pattern_fill
description: Steps menu state and sets tags, then on the escape value calls several routines and a pattern-based fill. The menu loop structure matches the other menu-loop routines in this bundle.

name: fill_rows_with_cycling_longwords
description: Fills 200 rows of a buffer, forty longwords per row, with a cycling pattern of thirteen longwords read from memory, then returns. The pattern is the same as in the other row-fill routines in this bundle.

name: set_tag_and_call_sequence
description: Calls a sequence of routines, sets a four-letter tag value, calls another routine, and then reads a thirteen-longword pattern from memory.

name: fill_spaces_and_copy_table
description: Fills a 40-byte buffer with space characters, then copies a block of longword data from a fixed source into a buffer offset from a global pointer.

name: read_text_input_into_buffer
description: Collects input characters into a buffer until a carriage-return value, decimal 13, or a limit of forty characters is reached. It then sets a tag and copies a 40-byte block, and it also handles the escape value.

name: start_menu_loop_with_copy
description: Sets a four-letter tag, copies a 40-byte block, then runs a menu loop that steps the state from flag bits and handles the escape value.

name: copy_longword_table_to_buffer
description: Copies a block of longwords in a loop of 112 passes from a fixed table into a buffer at an offset from a global pointer.

name: place_entry_at_computed_offset
description: Computes a horizontal position as a global index times twenty plus eighty-eight, passes it with a fixed value and a fixed pointer to a routine, then calls another routine.

name: display_lap_option_labels
description: Passes fixed screen positions and text references, including the labels FULL LAP, HALF LAP and HIGH, to a routine in sequence.

name: display_high_option_label
description: Passes fixed screen positions and text references, including the label HIGH, to a routine. The first text argument is chosen by a flag value.

name: run_option_screen_sequence
description: Waits for a flag bit, then runs a long sequence of waits and state-tag settings with routine calls between them. Flag bits select which part of the sequence runs.

name: compute_scaled_table_offset
description: Computes a value from a table lookup indexed by a scaled division result, then adds scaled terms and clamps the total against limits in a loop.

name: accumulate_scaled_terms_with_wrap
description: Adds scaled terms and fixed offsets to a global value in a loop, wrapping it when it falls below a lower limit. It copies two words from one fixed location to another and calls routines on each pass.

name: update_value_with_wrap_limit
description: Adds a scaled term and fixed offsets to a global value, wrapping it at a lower limit. It then copies two words, takes the absolute values of two others, and calls a routine on each pass of the loop.

name: compute_ratio_table_value
description: Takes the absolute values of two words, divides the smaller by the larger, and looks up the quotient in a 16-bit table to produce a negated value. Routine calls are made within the loop.

name: call_routine_per_list_entry
description: Walks a list held behind a global pointer until a minus-one entry, calling a routine for each entry with a running value that rises by sixteen per entry.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on memory or registers.

name: copy_records_from_source_lists
description: Copies a longword and a word from two source lists into record fields for each entry, advancing through the lists and the records by fixed steps.

name: clear_and_initialize_records
description: Zeroes a block of four-longword groups, then initializes a set of record fields to zero or ten. It matches a value against a three-word table to store one pointer field.

name: update_record_positions_and_timers
description: For a record, adds its velocity words to its position words when a flag bit is set, and otherwise runs a countdown field and a related bit test. The updated record is copied to a destination buffer.

name: ease_values_toward_targets
description: Moves two record fields halfway toward their target fields on each pass. It then sets a value to one of two fixed magnitudes chosen by a bit test, and tail-branches into the setup routine.

name: update_record_array_state
description: Loops over an array of records, halving the difference between fields and their targets, selecting values from bit tests, and calling several routines per record. Several counters and flags control the branches.

name: find_rectangle_containing_point
description: Searches a minus-one terminated list of rectangles for one that contains the position held in the record's fields. On a match it copies the record's first three words into fixed globals and calls a routine if one field is above nineteen.

name: search_next_rectangle_match
description: Continues the rectangle search from the current list position. On a match it copies the record's first three words into fixed globals and calls a routine if one field is above nineteen, and it returns when the list sentinel is reached.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on memory or registers.

name: configure_audio_period_and_volume
description: Sets a timing value from a mode counter, then writes values to the audio period and volume registers for channel zero, along with several display-size constants. Its branches depend on whether the counter is below four.

name: apply_collision_offset_adjustment
description: Copies three record fields into globals, then when a flag bit is set takes the absolute value of one field, subtracts twenty, and if the result is non-negative calls a routine and subtracts its result from a global.

name: copy_negated_camera_position
description: Stores negated record fields into globals, with a fixed offset added to one of them, then returns the input byte ORed with a fixed mask.

name: compute_camera_angle_from_ratio
description: Copies two words to globals, then takes the absolute values of two others, divides the smaller by the larger, and looks up the quotient in a 16-bit table. The negated result is stored into several globals.

name: compute_negated_table_angle
description: Computes a negated value from a table lookup of a scaled division. The value is used by the angle code that calls this routine.

name: compute_camera_angle_offset
description: Subtracts a fixed amount from a global, copies two words to fixed globals, and computes a negated angle from the ratio of two absolute values using a table. The result is stored in a global.

name: store_negated_table_angle
description: Computes a negated value from a table lookup of a scaled division and stores it in one global. It is a short helper for the angle computations.

name: dispatch_camera_mode_states
description: Steps a camera-mode counter from input bits, then dispatches on the mode value. Each mode sets a pair of fixed globals and calls a routine.

name: copy_longword_groups_with_sentinel
description: Copies groups of four longwords from a source into a buffer for a counted number of groups. It clamps the destination pointer to a fixed end address and writes a sentinel longword there.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on memory or registers.

name: copy_quad_blocks_to_targets
description: Copies four-longword blocks from a source list into two destinations, advancing the second destination by a fixed step after every eleven blocks. The source pointer is clamped to a fixed lower bound.

name: fill_longwords_with_pattern
description: Fills a counted run of longwords with a fixed repeating-nibble pattern. It then sets a global pointer to a fixed end address.

name: initialize_records_and_accumulate
description: If the count is zero it clears a flag bit, sets default values and returns. Otherwise it clears flag bits on a set of records, sets fixed defaults in one record, and accumulates values from the others.

name: integrate_records_with_damping
description: For each record with a nonzero counter, adds scaled velocity terms to its position words and decreases a damping counter by ten toward zero. Routines are called for each active record.

name: claim_free_record_slot
description: Finds the first empty slot in a record table, marks it in use, and copies position words from the input. It then sets several fields from a routine's result and a lookup table.

name: advance_active_records_and_copy
description: For each active record, adds velocity terms to its position fields and increments a field. A record is copied into a buffer when one position passes a limit.

name: initialize_record_fields_from_base
description: Calls a routine, then sets a group of record fields to a base value plus fixed offsets. Two of the offsets are skipped for certain base values.

name: scan_records_with_sentinel
description: Walks a list of eight-byte entries until a sentinel value. Entries with a nonzero field are compared through routine calls.

name: walk_linked_list_calling_routine
description: Walks a linked list in which each node's first longword is the next pointer. For each node it copies three fields into globals and calls a routine.

name: compute_offsets_within_bounds
description: Checks a point against a set of bounds using words from a record. When the comparisons pass it computes scaled products of the offsets and returns their combination.

name: insert_node_into_sorted_list
description: Inserts a node into a list kept in order of its key field, linking it ahead of the first node with a larger key. The node's remaining fields are then stored.

name: draw_ground_segment_list
description: Scans a list of ground segment records for one at or beyond a threshold, then calls setup routines. It processes the segments that match a fixed flag pattern and walks the rest with a loop.

name: process_ground_segment_group
description: Scans a segment list the same way as the ground-drawing routine before it, then calls setup routines and walks the segment records. Records that match a fixed flag pattern are processed.

name: or_segment_flags_and_process
description: Walks a segment list and calls a routine for each entry. For each flagged entry it ORs a run of flag words together and calls a routine when the combined value matches a fixed mask.

name: dispatch_matching_segment_entry
description: Clears a global, then walks a segment list ORing flag words for each flagged entry. When the combined value matches a fixed mask it stores a byte and calls through a table entry.

name: dispatch_segment_entry_by_mask
description: Clears a global and walks a segment list, ORing flag words for flagged entries. When the combined value matches a fixed mask it calls through a table entry.

name: find_flagged_segment_and_call
description: Walks a segment list calling routines for each entry, then scans forward for the next flagged entry. It calls through a table entry with the value found.

name: dispatch_flagged_segment_by_table
description: Clears a global, then walks a segment list to the first flagged entry and calls through a table entry chosen from that entry's value. It returns when the list ends.

name: select_ratio_routine_by_magnitude
description: Takes the absolute values of two words, then calls one of two routines depending on which value is smaller. The result is left in the return register.

name: lookup_quadrant_table_value
description: Looks up a sign-adjusted value from a table, reducing the input angle into one of four quadrants. Each quadrant reflects or negates the table entry.

name: lookup_offset_quadrant_value
description: Looks up a sign-adjusted table value for an input angle, using a quarter-offset within the table for each quadrant. It is the companion of the other quadrant lookup.

name: divide_fixed_point_by_iteration
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 16-bit divisor using an iterative averaging loop that returns early once the estimate stops changing. Large and small inputs take separate paths.

name: lookup_scaled_table_by_range
description: Looks up a value in a table using an index taken from the input's upper bits. The routine selects a shift and scale based on which magnitude range the input falls in.

name: get_track_section_index
description: Compares an input value against a long sequence of thresholds, adding a fixed step each time one is exceeded. The result is the accumulated index of the section.

name: prepare_signed_operands_for_divide
description: Halves both operands when the first is negative, then checks a sign condition on the remainder before returning. It tail-branches into the remainder helper.

name: adjust_signed_operand_for_divide
description: Halves an operand pair when the first is negative and checks a sign condition on the remainder before returning. It is a shorter form of the operand preparation routine.

name: compute_signed_remainder_check
description: Halves operands when the first is negative, then checks the sign of a signed remainder before returning. Other division routines call it.

name: run_division_step_loop
description: Selects a helper routine by a table index, then runs a counted loop that calls it repeatedly. The loop accumulates a remainder-style result with conditional subtracts, and its direction depends on which operand is larger.

name: run_subtract_restore_loop
description: Calls a helper routine through a pointer repeatedly, subtracting each result from a running value and adding back a constant when the subtraction borrows. It loops until the counter wraps.

name: run_division_loop_either_branch
description: Calls a helper routine repeatedly in one of two loop forms, chosen by which of two counters is larger. It accumulates a remainder-style result on each pass.

name: run_subtract_restore_loop
description: Calls a helper routine through a pointer repeatedly, subtracting each result from a running value and adding back a constant when the subtraction borrows. It loops until the counter wraps.

name: divide_by_helper_steps
description: Chooses one of two loop forms based on the magnitudes of the operands. It calls a helper routine through a pointer on each step to build a quotient-style result.

name: run_subtract_restore_loop
description: Calls a helper routine through a pointer repeatedly, subtracting each result from a running value and adding back a constant when the subtraction borrows. It loops until the counter wraps.

name: run_division_loop_either_branch
description: Calls a helper routine repeatedly in one of two loop forms, chosen by which of two counters is larger. It accumulates a remainder-style result on each pass.

name: run_subtract_restore_loop
description: Calls a helper routine through a pointer repeatedly, subtracting each result from a running value and adding back a constant when the subtraction borrows. It loops until the counter wraps.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so no behaviour was recovered for this routine. It is a stub.

name: xor_object_word_with_register
description: XORs a register word into one word at a fixed offset of an object pointed to by an address register, then returns.

name: and_register_into_target_word
description: ANDs a register word into the word pointed to by an address register, then returns.

name: or_register_into_target_word
description: ORs a register word into the word pointed to by an address register, then returns.

name: and_register_into_offset_word
description: ANDs a register word into one word at a fixed offset of an object pointed to by an address register, then returns.

name: patch_instruction_to_return
description: ORs the 68000 return-from-subroutine opcode into an instruction word at a stored address, which turns that location into a return. It then ORs and ANDs register words into three fields of an object.

name: update_entries_from_pointer_table
description: Loops over a counted list of pointers, copying two fields from each entry into globals and calling a routine per entry. It updates a counter after the loop.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns immediately. It is an empty stub with no effect on memory or registers.

name: call_routine_counted_times
description: Calls a routine repeatedly for a counted number of passes, decrementing the count until it passes minus one, then returns.

name: wait_then_compare_scaled_terms
description: Waits for a global to become nonzero, then computes scaled squared and product terms and compares their absolute values. It calls one of several routines depending on the result.

name: divide_and_pack_quotient_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 16-bit global, returning the remainder in the upper word and the quotient in the lower word.

name: divide_and_pack_quotient_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 16-bit global, returning the remainder in the upper word and the quotient in the lower word.

name: divide_and_pack_quotient_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 16-bit global, returning the remainder in the upper word and the quotient in the lower word.

name: divide_and_pack_quotient_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 16-bit global, returning the remainder in the upper word and the quotient in the lower word.

name: fill_table_rows_minus_one
description: Sets globals based on the sign of an input value, then fills groups of longwords in a table with the value minus one, four at a time, at fixed offsets.

name: fill_table_rows_minus_one
description: Sets globals based on the sign of an input value, then fills groups of longwords in a table with the value minus one. The sign selection is the reverse of the routine before it.

name: fill_table_rows_minus_one
description: Sets globals based on the sign of an input value, then fills groups of longwords in a table with the value minus one, using a longer fill sequence.

name: spin_unless_values_match
description: Calls a routine, then returns if two globals are equal. If they differ it loops forever without returning.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so no behaviour was recovered for this routine. It is a stub.

name: stub_empty_return
description: The decompiled body is only a return, so no behaviour was recovered for this routine. It is a stub.

name: read_disk_track_with_retries
description: Sets up a disk read through the controller's sync word and DMA registers, then waits for the transfer to finish or time out. It checks disk status and interrupt bits and returns a result code.

name: retry_disk_read_until_limit
description: Retries the disk read routine up to a fixed count, returning a failure code of three when the count is exhausted.

name: step_disk_head_to_track
description: Moves the disk head one track at a time toward a target track by driving the step and direction bits of the second CIA port. A global track counter is updated on each step.

name: pulse_disk_step_with_delays
description: Pulses a disk control line with busy-wait delay counts around each step, repeating until the requested track matches. It then restores a saved counter.

name: busy_wait_for_count
description: Counts a register down to minus one as a delay loop, then stores a saved value into a global and returns.

name: set_cia_port_upper_bits
description: Sets a global to 255 and rewrites the upper control bits of a CIA port to a fixed pattern, leaving the lower bits unchanged.

name: clear_and_set_control_bits
description: Clears a global, then clears bit three and sets bit seven of a CIA port control byte. The other bits of that byte are kept.

name: poll_disk_status_with_pulses
description: Pulses a bit of a control register with busy-wait delays while a status flag is set, then clears two globals and sets a bit in the register. The register is the joystick and disk status port.

name: clear_globals_set_bit_two
description: Clears two globals and sets bit two of the control byte at the pointer.

name: hash_uppercase_text_eleven_bits
description: Computes an eleven-bit hash of a zero-terminated text by folding each character, converted to uppercase, into a running total. The total is scaled by thirteen, negated when a sign flag is set.

name: fold_text_into_product_hash
description: Multiplies two inputs, negating one when a sign flag is set. It then folds each character of a zero-terminated text, uppercased, into an eleven-bit value that includes the product.

name: write_pattern_word_to_targets
description: Writes a fixed 16-bit pattern to two address-register targets, then returns the input byte ORed with a fixed mask.

name: copy_indexed_longwords_to_buffer
description: Copies a list of longwords chosen by an index table into a destination buffer. It then calls a routine with the final pointer.

name: dispatch_entries_through_code_table
description: Walks a list of entries, computes a table index from each entry's fields, and calls a routine from a code table with the entry's values.

name: clip_segment_to_bounds
description: Clips a line segment against a set of bounds, computing each intersection from the quotient and remainder of coordinate differences. The clipped endpoints are written to output buffers.

name: compute_clipped_intersection_point
description: Computes an intersection coordinate from a quotient and remainder of coordinate differences, adjusting the sign for negative values. Four routines are called along the way.

name: multiply_coordinate_differences
description: Returns the product of a difference in one coordinate and a difference in another, as a signed 32-bit value.

name: multiply_offset_differences
description: Returns the product of two coordinate differences, computed from signed words, as a 32-bit value.

name: multiply_coordinate_differences
description: Returns the product of a difference in one coordinate and a difference in another, as a signed 32-bit value.

name: store_offset_clipped_coordinate
description: Makes a divisor positive, adjusts a quotient for negative remainders, and stores the resulting offset coordinate into an output buffer.

name: store_clipped_coordinate_value
description: Normalises a divisor's sign, adjusts a quotient for negative remainders, and stores the resulting value into an output buffer.

name: copy_pairs_until_mode_one
description: Inverts a global and, when it is nonzero, stores a register value and returns. Otherwise it copies register values into an output buffer in pairs until a mode value of one is reached, with modes two to four handled first.

name: copy_value_pairs_by_mode
description: If a global is zero, stores a register value and returns. Otherwise it copies the register value into an output buffer in pairs, stepping through mode values until a mode of one is reached.

name: copy_value_pairs_by_mode
description: Copies a register value into an output buffer in pairs for each mode value until a mode of one is reached, with modes two to four handled first. It returns on mode one.

name: copy_value_pairs_by_mode
description: Copies register values into an output buffer in pairs, stopping on a mode of one. Modes two and three branch to a separate exit.

name: negate_corner_coordinates
description: Negates selected corner coordinates when a comparison holds, subtracting one from each negated value, and stores the adjusted corners into output fields.

name: scale_point_coordinates
description: Multiplies two coordinates and a third value from a point record by a scalar, stores the scaled products in an output record, and negates one stored value.

name: sum_three_indexed_components
description: For each entry, adds three indexed component values together and branches on the sign of the total. A negative total is negated before it is used.

name: divide_with_range_checks
description: Divides one coordinate by a scale with overflow and range checks that raise traps on bad results. It then steps through clip decisions that compare a running value with limits.

name: divide_negated_with_range_checks
description: Computes a quotient with negation, overflow checks and range checks. The form of the result is chosen from comparisons of the operands, and the clip steps follow.

name: divide_clip_steps_range_checked
description: Divides a coordinate by a scale with range checks, then runs the clip-step loop comparing a running value with limits. Overflow raises a trap.

name: sum_and_divide_clip_steps
description: Sums two coordinates, negates the sum when it is negative, and divides by a scale with range checks. The result feeds the clip-step loop.

name: divide_clip_steps_with_negation
description: Divides a coordinate by a scale and negates the quotient before the clip-step loop. The loop compares a running value with limits on each pass.

name: divide_negated_with_range_checks
description: Computes a quotient with negation, overflow checks and range checks. The form of the result is chosen from comparisons of the operands, and the clip steps follow.

name: divide_clip_steps_range_checked

name: encode_region_codes
description: Builds a region-code word for each point by XOR-ing flag bits according to comparisons against bounds. Each code is stored with its coordinates into an output buffer.

name: store_region_code_entries
description: Stores a region-code word and coordinates for each point in an output buffer, setting one flag bit from a comparison against a bound. The loop runs over the input list until its end marker.

name: clip_vertex_list_against_edge
description: Walks a vertex list and tests each vertex and its neighbour against a clip edge using table lookups. Crossing points are written to output, with routine calls for each pair.

name: write_complemented_sign_byte
description: Stores a sign byte, complemented, into an output buffer. It then walks the input list to compute and store further edge values.

name: write_complemented_sign_and_step
description: Stores a complemented sign byte into an output buffer and advances the output pointer. It continues stepping through the input entries.

name: compute_edge_side_flag
description: Computes a side flag byte from the sign of a cross product of coordinate differences. The byte is inverted when a mode bit is set, and it is stored in an output buffer.

name: classify_edge_endpoints
description: Compares coordinate differences of an edge's endpoints against clip thresholds. It branches to one of several output paths.

name: compute_edge_side_flag
description: Computes a side flag byte from the sign of a cross product of coordinate differences. The byte is inverted when a mode bit is set, and it is stored in an output buffer.

name: store_edge_side_value
description: Stores a side value, inverted when a mode bit is set, into an output pointer. It returns when the input list ends.

name: store_side_flags_and_continue
description: Sets side flag bytes for each entry in the input list and stores them in order. It tail-branches into the vertex-list routine once the list is exhausted.

name: store_side_flags_loop
description: Writes side flag bytes for each entry in a loop, inverting them when a mode bit is set. The loop ends when the list sentinel is reached.

name: store_side_flag_value
description: Computes a side value from two edge differences and stores it, inverting it when a mode bit is set. It then continues the flag loop.

name: install_vector_and_scan_table
description: Writes a value into a vector slot, then scans a table of longwords for its minimum and maximum. The results are stored in globals.

name: scan_longword_table_min_max
description: Scans a table of longwords for their minimum and maximum values, then stores both results. The loop runs over a counted number of entries.

name: step_global_and_return_pair
description: Advances a global index by one, loads a byte from a table at that index into the global, calls a routine, and returns two register values.

name: select_setup_value_by_state
description: Chooses a setup value from a state global, with separate branches for states zero, one and two. When the state is not two it returns the state minus two.

name: populate_code_table_entries
description: Stores a computed word into a code table slot, then loops over the remaining table entries writing a further computed word for each.

name: fill_code_table_from_offsets
description: Fills a code table from a computed starting value, storing an offset word for each slot and advancing both table pointers each pass.

name: populate_code_table_with_origin
description: Populates a code table from a computed starting value, looping over its entries and calling nine routines. It tail-branches into the origin routine at the end.
